soundness_flags.label: oeq:uniform-generated-residual-expansion
soundness_flags.one_line: “Every permitted cross-fitted local-polynomial nuisance fit” is not a defined estimator class: folds, polynomial orders, bandwidth/selection rules, boundary treatment, and the uniform admissibility condition are absent, so the universal deviation claim has no determinate domain.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:uniform-minimax-frontier and thm:simultaneous-graph-confidence-set
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The matching upper frontier and singleton-confidence conclusion are conditional on an affirmative resolution of oeq:uniform-generated-residual-expansion.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The unconditional field claim is the attainable-margin geometry plus legal-mirror converse; the matching upper and confidence claims hold only under an explicitly constructed uniform orthogonal generated-residual expansion.

source_verification_receipts.locator: PMLR record, bibliographic entry and abstract
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper exists as Li et al., PMLR 267:35753--35768 (2025), studies strong/weak identifiability in nonlinear ANMs, and introduces GENE as an order-based method using conditional-independence tests.
Condition 19 defines the identifiable bivariate ANM restriction; Definition 27 defines restricted ANMs; Theorem 28 identifies a restricted ANM graph under causal minimality.
The paper proves consistency of fixed-kernel fitted-residual HSIC under suitable regression and characteristic-kernel conditions, with convergence to population residual HSIC.
The paper studies two-variable causal-structure learning with observational and interventional samples on a finite domain and characterizes observational--interventional tradeoffs.
The public v1 states the sharp bivariate linear-LiNGAM law N*_2(beta,nu,delta) asymptotic to log(1/delta)/(d_beta^2+beta^2 nu^2), using edge, non-Gaussianity, and scale-uncertainty margins.
The paper constructs estimated-residual independence tests in nonparametric heteroscedastic regression and investigates null and alternative asymptotics.

source_verification_receipts.locator: publication record and abstract, lines 22--35 and 59--96
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article constructs residual-bootstrap goodness-of-fit confidence sets for causal orderings and establishes asymptotic validity.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the admissible nuisance-fit class in the OEQ: give fold allocation, polynomial order, a deterministic or explicitly selected bandwidth range, tail/boundary rule, and the uniform high-probability regression guarantee that the claimed fourth-order remainder consumes.

Add a proved average-Hamming-risk corollary on the same mirror family, explicitly contrasting its no-log-d boundary with exact recovery; it makes the logarithmic simultaneous-loss contribution easier to assess without claiming a new standalone kernel.

Make the orthogonalization target operational by writing the first and second Gateaux derivative terms and the proposed projected correction as explicit population formulas before asking for their estimators and concentration bound.

recommended_next_step: Revise the OEQ and every conditional consumer theorem to quantify over a formally defined local-polynomial nuisance-fit class; then retain the attainable-rectangle and legal-mirror lower-bound kernel for Stage 0.
